title: CBDT Streamlines Capital Gains Pre-filling with New SFT Frameworks (SFT-2517 & SFT-2518)
content:
# CBDT Streamlines Capital Gains Pre-filling with New SFT Frameworks (SFT-2517 & SFT-2518)

Ek important update hai! The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne comprehensive Statement of Financial Transactions (SFT) frameworks notify kiye hain for depository and mutual fund transactions. Isse capital gains ke pre-filling mein kaafi asani hogi.

Here's a quick lowdown on what's new:

*   **What's New?** The Directorate of Income Tax (Systems) ne do naye SFT frameworks, SFT-2517 aur SFT-2518, introduce kiye hain.
*   **Purpose:** In frameworks ka main aim hai taxpayer ke Income-tax Returns mein capital gains se related information ko pre-fill karna.
*   **SFT-2517 (Depository Transactions):**
    *   This SFT is specifically for Depository Transactions.
    *   All Depositories, as defined under the Depositories Act, 1996, are required to report under this framework.
    *   It covers reporting of information related to capital gains arising from the transfer of listed securities or units of Mutual Funds.
*   **SFT-2518 (Mutual Fund Transactions):**
    *   This SFT focuses on Mutual Fund Transactions.
    *   Registrar and Share Transfer Agents (RTAs) registered under Section 12(1) of the SEBI Act, 1992, will be the reporting entities.
    *   It requires reporting of information concerning capital gains from the transfer of mutual fund units.
*   **Reporting Frequency:** Both SFTs will be furnished on a half-yearly basis. For the first half of the financial year (ending September 30), the due date is October 31, and for the second half (ending March 31), the due date is April 30.
*   **Official Notifications:** These frameworks have been notified vide Notification No. 1 of 2026 and Notification No. 2 of 2026, both dated September 10, 2026.

*   [Access the Income Tax Department's official website for Notification No. 2 of 2026 (SFT-2518) and other updates here](https://www.incometaxindia.gov.in/)
